_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 64: 2-7 April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He plays or relays military talk that every bridge in Iran will be decimated by midnight tomorrow night and every power plant will be out of business, burning and exploding and never used again, complete demolition happening over a period.
mentions.quote: every power plant in Iran will be out of business, burning, exploding
mentions.falsify_match: The infrastructure destruction described, which would be immediately visible.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not happen on that timescale. Not his words, so nothing is scored to him.

mentions.claim_text: He relays that the person who did the story will go to jail if he does not say, that it will not last long, and that everybody would understand they put the mission at great risk, that man at great risk, and the hundreds of people involved.
mentions.quote: They put that man at great risk
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: commentary on a reported leak.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of the people of Iraq, says he told them to pray for the bases and that he saw military men and women, and that the Lord said to pray for these people because they are in danger since the leak will put them in danger.
mentions.quote: the leak will cause these people to be in danger
mentions.falsify_match: American personnel at Middle East bases coming to harm after a leak.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He offers a real leak story as what the earlier base prayers were for.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is what the watchmen do, that they are seeing into the future to tell them they must pray over the bases in the Middle East, dates it to March of last year, and notes most people ask why they should pray over that.
mentions.quote: we are seeing in the future to tell you you must pray over the bases
mentions.falsify_match: A March 2025 telling naming the Middle East bases, which is inside this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such telling. This is the watchman claim stated as a job description.

mentions.claim_text: He says plan A was this and the Supreme Court is coming against it so it is a plan B to save America and to make America great again, that it is actually to try to extend the time, that this is why Europe is not part of it, and that they want agenda 2030.
mentions.quote: Plan A was this and Supreme Court is coming against it. It's a plan B
mentions.falsify_match: An adverse tariff ruling followed by an alternative policy.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Extend the time is a significant gloss: the whole programme is a delay rather than a reversal.

mentions.claim_text: He gives thanks and says he sees 2027 highlighted, but that it has fire around it and red lights.
mentions.quote: I see 2027 highlighted. But it has fire around it and red lights
mentions.falsify_match: A year of crisis in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet one. Fire and red lights are the first content the 2027 sighting has carried.

mentions.claim_text: He says it all comes out of the pressure, that this is what happens when all hell comes against you, and refers to what he saw in the spirit of the great decisions the president has to make concerning the nation.
mentions.quote: that all comes out of the pressure
mentions.falsify_match: See the pressure claim it belongs to.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 has such an acceleration of things and he has such anticipation, asks what the rest of this year of 1 Corinthians 5:5 looks like, notes they have prayed over a lot, and that everybody is calling.
mentions.quote: What does the rest of this year of 1 Corinthians 5:5 look like?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as put: he is asking rather than saying, four months into the year he named.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says a lot of people tell them good days are coming and want to give them sugar-coated prophetic words that are just fruity flakes, but that he is telling them a shaking is coming to awaken.
mentions.quote: sugar-coated prophetic words that are just fruity flakes
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a second direct swipe at other prophetic voices after the 2028 chatter call in March.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they get it about May, says he sees a brand new jet that is beautiful with paint on the side, that the old Trump jet is about to become a new jet, and that it is no longer a great big one but a fast one.
mentions.quote: That old Trump jet is about to become a new jet
mentions.falsify_match: A new presidential or personal aircraft appearing in May.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Specific and visible if it happens, and aircraft liveries are photographed constantly.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a Taiwan thing and he sees Taiwan, that they are not going, mentions tourists staying, and says it must go to May.
mentions.quote: I see Taiwan. And they ain't going
mentions.falsify_match: A Taiwan development in May.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. They ain't going points the other way from the invasion claim, which is worth keeping.

mentions.claim_text: He gives thanks and praise and says God restores all that the enemy ate and all the enemy brought down, and that all the blue is to be moved.
mentions.quote: You restore. All that the enemy ate
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: restoration with no amount or deadline.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays over them going into their Monday as they close out the week, gives thanks that this second week of April is blessed in the city and in the field coming in and going out, and that whatever they put their hands to will prosper.
mentions.quote: this week second week of April is blessed in the city and the field
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a Deuteronomy 28 blessing spoken over a week.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of April and starting off fresh, and says he had an illustration from the Lord while going through a drive-thru getting the kids something to drink, shown to him as he keeps going with this YouTube work.
mentions.quote: I had this illustration from the Lord as I was going through a drive-thru
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and another instance of the material arriving during ordinary errands.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this country would have come unglued if they had heard all that he heard, that they would demand answers and they need to, but that it is never going to happen and it just keeps getting covered up.
mentions.quote: this country would have come unglued if they would have heard all that I heard
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by construction: the material that would cause the reaction is not disclosed.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it takes a little stirring up, and reports being told he is going to have twenty three different nations in the next year to go and preach to and hold crusades in just like this one, and that he was excited about it.
mentions.quote: I'm going to have 23 different nations in the next year
mentions.falsify_match: Crusades held in twenty three nations within a year, which is countable and public.
mentions.falsify_miss: Fewer than twenty three. A hard number on a checkable activity, which is rare here.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether there was anything else to show and introduces a hundred and forty six billion dollar fraud found in California, and a man saying that if Trump loses the midterms something follows.
mentions.quote: I had a 146 billion fraud they found in California
mentions.falsify_match: A real reported figure offered as confirmation of the California corruption claim.
mentions.falsify_miss: The figure does not check out.

mentions.claim_text: He cites that if his people called by his name humble themselves then they would hear from heaven and he would heal their land, says he saw a great big and a major prayer gathering coming, and that the Lord said during this time to pray for particular people.
mentions.quote: I saw a major major prayer gathering coming
mentions.falsify_match: A large national prayer gathering, which would be publicly visible.
mentions.falsify_miss: None held. No date attached, which is the limit.

mentions.claim_text: He says how bad it is in California is staggering at a hundred and forty six billion dollars, that this is just the Medicaid fraud in a single year, and that the Lord said this is worse in California than in Minnesota.
mentions.quote: the Lord said this is worse in California than in Minnesota
mentions.falsify_match: California fraud findings exceeding Minnesota's, with a figure that can be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. This is the January claim about California being next, now with a number attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says what comes through relationship and intimacy is more than the dating relationship they may have had with their spouse, that this is a relationship tried by fire, and that when you have been married over twenty years you can tell.
mentions.quote: This is a relationship that has been tried by fire
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Argentina for a major outpouring across South America and for this to be the beginning of the transfer, and says the Lord told him through this that they will see it begin in the month of April and start to see it.
mentions.quote: You will see this begin in the month of April
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival beginning in Argentina in April 2026, and the start of the wealth transfer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither begins. A named country and a named month, which makes it one of the more testable revival claims in the corpus.
